correctness.rationale: For each s>=0, g(s,u)=0 has unique u(s), g_u>0, g_s<0, hence u'(s)>0. Its composition H(s) strictly decreases from sum a_i d_i/m_i to zero, including cases p_i=0, proving exact existence and uniqueness. Block elimination in the actual (n+2)-dimensional DDE gives det M(0)=s prod D_i g_u H'(s)<0; det M(x)/x^(n+2) tends to one on positive reals, forcing a positive real root. The eigenmode satisfies the linearized biological infection-history integral. Independent numerical Jacobian assembly and compatibility checks for 2 and 3 types corroborate the proof but do not substitute for it.

value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper explicitly leaves arbitrary unequal-delay coexistence existence at one-sided necessary conditions and computes positive characteristic roots only numerically. The new theorem supplies a complete sharp high-dose iff condition, a global count of positive equilibria (zero or one), and a rigorous real spectral instability mechanism for any number of distinct latency periods. This is a structural gap with a natural interpretation for nonproductive surviving bursts, not a numerical table, cosmetic reparameterization, or negligible cutoff.
